name: Applied Optoelectronics

eyebrow.en: Applied Optoelectronics, Inc. · Common stock · Sugar Land, Texas
eyebrow.zh: Applied Optoelectronics · 普通股 · 德州糖城

title.zh: 全力扩建 800G 与 1.6T 产能。

lede.en: AOI makes optical transceivers and lasers, now mostly for AI data centers. Revenue rose 86% to a record $192M last quarter and is guided to $255–290M. To meet demand it is building over 1.6M sq ft of factories in Texas, paid for largely by selling new shares.
lede.zh: AOI 生产光模块与激光器，现主要供应 AI 数据中心。上季营收增 86% 至创纪录的 1.92 亿美元，本季指引 2.55–2.9 亿。为满足需求，公司在德州兴建逾 160 万平方英尺厂房，资金主要来自增发新股。

s.zh: 2026 第三季 · 日期未公布

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. The stock went from about $19 to $234 within the year and now sits near $110; beta is about 3.8.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。一年内股价由约 $19 涨至 $234，现约 $110；贝塔值约 3.8。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with GAAP gross margin on the right axis. Q4 2024 GAAP EPS of −$2.60 reflects a one-time non-cash charge. The last bar is guidance at the midpoint.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为 GAAP 毛利率。2024 年第四季 GAAP 每股 −$2.60 反映一次性非现金费用。最后一根柱为指引中值。

s.zh: 同比 +86% · 连续第5季创纪录
同比逾10倍 · Q3 指引再增约5倍

p.en: AOI holds more than $200M of firm 1.6T orders and expected to finish qualification with a major hyperscaler, its fourth approved supplier slot.
p.zh: AOI 持有逾 2 亿美元 1.6T 确定订单，预计完成一家大型云厂商认证，成为其第四家合格供应商。

p.en: 800G/1.6T capacity goes from about 200,000 units a month to over 650,000 by end-2026 and 930,000 by end-2027, more than half in Texas.
p.zh: 800G/1.6T 月产能将由约 20 万件增至 2026 年底逾 65 万、2027 年底 93 万，半数以上在德州。

p.en: DSP and TIA chip supply, not demand, limits 1.6T shipments; memory shortages cost $20–25M of 100G revenue in Q3.
p.zh: DSP 与 TIA 芯片供应（而非需求）限制 1.6T 出货；内存短缺使 Q3 的 100G 收入减少 2000–2500 万美元。

p.en: Capex was $565M in Q2, funded by $539M of at-the-market share sales. More issuance is likely while the build-out continues.
p.zh: 第二季资本开支 5.65 亿美元，由 5.39 亿美元市价增发支持。扩建期间可能继续增发。

p.en: Target: $70–80M of 1.6T revenue, limited by component supply.
p.zh: 目标：1.6T 收入 7000–8000 万美元，受零部件供应限制。

p.en: Pearland and Houston facilities come online.
p.zh: Pearland 与休斯敦工厂投产。

sources: Price, market cap and beta: Financial Modeling Prep, as of Oct 9, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 9, 2026. For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Applied Optoelectronics, Inc..
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月9日。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Applied Optoelectronics, Inc. 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q3 2021 to Q2 2026. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 2021 年第三季至 2026 年第二季共 20 个季度。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

s.zh: 2026年6月30日 · 已计 5.39 亿增发

read.en: AOI has burned cash in 18 of the last 20 quarters. The burn turned into a flood in Q2 2026: $575M of capex (including $280M of equipment prepayments) against barely positive operating cash flow, for free cash flow of −$564M.
read.zh: 过去 20 个季度中 AOI 有 18 个季度烧钱。2026 年第二季烧钱规模剧增：资本开支 5.75 亿美元（含 2.8 亿设备预付款），经营现金流仅略为正，自由现金流 −5.64 亿。

read.en: Management says second-half capital intensity will be even higher. I assume about $300M of capex in each of Q3 and Q4, easing in 2027 as plants open, and operating cash flow turning positive with revenue. That is about −$800M over four quarters, more than the $509M in the bank, so expect more share sales or borrowing.
read.zh: 管理层称下半年资本强度将更高。我假设 Q3、Q4 各约 3 亿美元资本开支，2027 年随工厂投产回落，经营现金流随营收转正。四季合计约 −8 亿美元，超过账上 5.09 亿现金，因此预计将继续增发或借款。

p.en: Over 1.6M sq ft of space; a 210,000 sq ft plant starts production late in Q3, with more sites in early 2027.
p.zh: 逾 160 万平方英尺厂房；21 万平方英尺工厂于 Q3 末投产，更多厂区 2027 年初启用。

p.en: $280M of Q2's capex was prepayments to lock in equipment.
p.zh: 第二季资本开支中 2.8 亿美元为锁定设备的预付款。

p.en: $646M of stock sold in Q2 and $382M in Q1 2026.
p.zh: 2026 年第二季发行股票 6.46 亿美元，第一季 3.82 亿。

p.en: Revenue guided to $255–290M in Q3, with 800G up about five-fold.
p.zh: Q3 营收指引 2.55–2.9 亿美元，800G 约增五倍。

bridgeNote.en: A negative result means AOI would need more equity or debt; it has been selling shares every quarter.
bridgeNote.zh: 结果为负意味着 AOI 需要更多股权或债务融资；公司每季都在增发。
